name: Agentic-Articles
headline: Agentic-Articles AI content creation tool
short_description: AgentArticle is an AI-driven application that streamlines content creation by combining web scraping, NLP, and AI tools to produce high-quality articles for LinkedIn and other social media platforms. It integrates APIs and Selenium automation, making it perfect for professionals, content creators, and marketers.
author: DissanayakeLYB

sections.overview:
AgentArticle combines web scraping, natural language processing, and AI to generate human-like articles for LinkedIn and social media. The tool automates Google searches using Selenium, extracts content from top results, and uses the Groq API to produce well-structured articles. Built-in AI content detection via Quillbot identifies machine-generated text, triggering automatic humanization until detection falls below 10%. Ideal for professionals, marketers, and content creators seeking to streamline article production while maintaining authenticity.
Generate LinkedIn articles from trending topics with minimal manual effort
Create social media content by scraping and synthesizing web information
Produce humanized AI articles that pass AI detection checks
Batch create marketing content while maintaining human-like quality
sections.setup:

sections.usage:
```
Create a LinkedIn article for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use the following data points: [DATA]. Ensure the article is engaging, informative, and optimized for LinkedIn's audience. Include a compelling headline, introduction, 3-5 key points, and a strong call-to-action.
```
